meta.notes: pack-4's chronicle templates (the T1 slice's tale lines). Tone per MVP_SCOPE §12: no LLM, no embellishment — the readability test (T7) runs on exactly this output. The displacement's rendering law: the LEVERS and their world-replies render as the tale's medium lines (the burn, the shock, the knocking, the collection, the warmth, the dread, the cold a burst collects); THE DEBT ITSELF never renders as a number — no template ever speaks a seam count (the thermometer minus, consequence-rendered). Syntax: {slot} binds event data; #symbol# expands the tracery grammar; {cond?a|b} is ink-style conditional text; lists are alternatives via the ink-shuffle ShufflePool (cosmetic stream). tale_gate.min_importance decides which events earn a line (tune-1's split: the rule owns the signal/noise boundary).

cold_sign: The radiators tick, patient as a counted debt.
fire_sign: The fire at the firehole breathes steady.
Coal settles in the grate with a soft knock.

events.boiler_run_hard: {actor} runs the machine hard — the iron past the red line.
events.seam_shocked: A seam lets go at {location}: the machine takes the shock.
events.pipes_knock: The pipes begin to knock at {location} — the walls carry it.
events.debt_collects: The debt collects: a seam bursts at {location}, and the heat dies with it.
events.dread_rises: The dread rises through the walls of {location}.
events.warmth_felt: Warmth spreads from the firehole through {location}.
events.the_bench_convenes: The bench convenes behind the registry door — the machine's books opened again.
events.the_watch_pleads: The tenants' watch stands at the firehole door: the rooms are cold, and they say so.
events.arrest_resolved: {caught?{target} is caught — the pursuit holds.|{target} slips away.}
